metadata.description: A collection of Agent Skills for GitHub Copilot, grouped into installable plugins.

plugins.name: testing
plugins.description: Write, review, and debug automated tests in whatever framework a repository already uses. Detects the stack at runtime rather than imposing a framework.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Review code against Google's Standard of Code Review, reporting findings with Conventional Comments labels and CWE-named security categories. Also generates a repository's agent and review rules files.

plugins.name: large-context
plugins.description: Answer counting, ranking, and exhaustive-coverage questions over corpora far larger than the context window — logs, tickets, contracts, papers, or a whole repository. Extracts every source unit into one fixed-schema table, verifies that none were dropped, and computes the answer by query rather than by reading.
